name: v1-agent-watcher
description: Inspect live Codex V1 child-agent rollouts so a parent agent can supervise local subagents.

interface.longDescription: Lets a Codex parent inspect recent reasoning and tool activity persisted by V1 child-agent rollout sessions, making it possible to detect loops and steer delegated local workers.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my currently running V1 subagent and tell me whether it needs guidance.
